text:
June: Morning mystery: a single fake sunflower was taped to the whiteboard overnight. Who is the Sunflower Senator?
Ravi: Not me. But if it's an office position I'm ready to campaign. Platform: longer lunch breaks and more neon pens. :sunflower:
Marta: Lore update: remember the "Tape Flag" era. This is clearly a sequel. :eyes:
Theo: Suggestion: form the Sunflower Senate. Duties include emoji adjudication and one ceremonial desk water every Friday.
ops-bot: Note: office decoration policy allows non-permanent tape-based items. Please no adhesives that leave residue.
Lina: I nominate a three-person Senate: one to seed, one to petition for snacks, and one to adjudicate plant disputes. Voting now pls.
June: Also propose a small insignia patch for the senator. I can sew tiny ribbons.
Ravi: Campaign slogan: "Bloom where you're placed." I'll make a tiny meme.
Marta: Thread poll: 1) Elect Ravi 2) Elect Lina 3) Rotate weekly 4) Keep mystery. React with 1/2/3/4 or reply.
Dev-Bot: Poll created: 1) Ravi 2) Lina 3) Rotate 4) Mystery. Voting open for 12h.
Theo: Rotate weekly! We need to spread the sunflower wealth. :raised_hands:
Lina: Vote Lina. Also reminder: Senate meeting will be two minutes, not a filibuster.
Ravi: Vote Ravi. Offer: I will host a micro-snack hour and supply stickers.
Marta: Vote Rotate. Also adding to lore: the sunflower gets a tiny nameplate.
ops-bot: Poll closed. Results: Ravi 2, Lina 1, Rotate 3, Mystery 1.
June: Rotate wins. I'll make a tiny rota doc. First rota: Ravi week 1, Lina week 2, Marta week 3.
Theo: Can we have ceremonial opening lines? I propose: "By the power vested in this tape, I declare the board bright." Short, theatrical.
Lina: Also adding an emergency fallback: if no one shows up, the office plant is honorary senator. :seedling:
June: Implementation notes: tiny nameplate on sunflower, weekly Slack ping from Dev-Bot as reminder, and a low-key sash for the incumbent.
Ravi: Accepting week 1 duties. Will bring stickers and a bowl of mini-pretzels. No promises on quality.
Marta: I'll design a 1" vinyl nameplate and a tiny digital badge. This is excellent. :sparkles:
ops-bot: Action: add a calendar event "Sunflower Senate handoff" Fridays 9:05am for weekly rotation.
June: Closing thread. New lore entry: "Sunflower Senate" recorded in breakroom ledger. Preserve tape, respect petals. :sun_with_face:
